summary: No repository holds a morphometric table or calibrated outline set of Vorticella bells across species. What exists is images: 82 Cell Image Library records (mostly V. convallaria), 156 GBIF occurrence photos, Plazi/Zenodo figures from taxonomic redescriptions with scale bars, and a Tara Oceans protist SEM collection. Fitting unduloids between measured end rings would require digitising outlines from these figures and from monographs (Kahl, Foissner), with species identity taken from the source paper.
next_step: Compile a figure set of 15–30 Vorticella species from Plazi/Zenodo redescriptions (each with scale bar and species), digitise the extended-bell meridian, record scopula and peristome diameters, and pre-register the unduloid fit.
obstacles_confirmed: Bell outlines are in monographs and scattered photographs, not a morphometric archive.
Most public images are 2D and not taxonomically balanced.
